responses.text: It's gotta be that castle that crazy guy said "blipped" into existence, right?  Over.
It's that place the teamster told me about.  Over.
It's that place from that sign I found.  Over.
From here it looks like a pile of scrap metal, but I can't really tell.  That mean anything to you?  Over.
I'll see what I can do.  Over and out.
Not now, Pat.  We'll talk about this later.  Over and out.
